human_name: FCGR2A/2B/2C/3A/3B low-affinity Fc-gamma receptor cluster at 1q23.3

GRCh38.note: Locus spans FCGR2A (chr1:161,505,415-161,524,013, +) through FCGR3A, FCGR2C, FCGR3B (161,623,196-161,631,963, -) and FCGR2B (161,662,803-161,679,490, +); 82.5 kb segmental-duplication unit underlies the CNV region containing FCGR3A/FCGR2C/FCGR3B but NOT FCGR2A or FCGR2B (Niederer 2010; Breunis 2009)

copy_count_typical: 2 (diploid wild-type); CNV range 1-4 copies of the FCGR3A/2C/3B-containing unit
architecture_note: Classical Lupski-style NAHR-prone DP-LCR. The 82.5 kb tandem-duplication unit is directly oriented and >98% identical, satisfying the canonical NAHR substrate criteria. NAHR products include FCGR3B deletion (RA / SLE / autoimmune risk), FCGR2C deletion, and chimeric FCGR2A/2C or FCGR3A/3B genes (Mueller 2013, Niederer 2010). FCGR2C is itself a chimeric pseudo-paralog: extracellular domain shared with FCGR2B, transmembrane/cytoplasmic with FCGR2A (Breunis 2008).

discriminating_snps.source: rs1801274; classical FCGR2A functional polymorphism affecting IgG2 binding affinity
discriminating_snps.note: Allele-frequency-balanced polymorphism (~0.5/0.5) used as PSV-style anchor distinguishing FCGR2A from FCGR2B/2C in the CNV region. NOT a paralog-discriminator per se but a clinically validated coding SNP.

discriminating_snps.source: rs396991; classical FCGR3A functional polymorphism affecting IgG1/IgG3 binding
discriminating_snps.note: Distinguishes FCGR3A from FCGR3B at the protein level (FCGR3B is GPI-anchored, lacks the cytoplasmic tail of FCGR3A); the V158F position is one of the diagnostic differences used in Niederer 2010 / Breunis 2009 read assignment.

NA1 vs NA2 (HNA-1a vs HNA-1b) is the classical FCGR3B-specific haplotype distinguishing the two common allotypes; relevant for CNV-on-haplotype-background interpretation. Coded here as 'N>N' because it is a multi-SNP block not a single substitution; see Niederer 2010 supplementary for PSV table.

diagnostic_features.psv_strategy_note: Niederer 2010 published a detailed PSV table for the 82.5 kb LCR (supplementary Table S2 of HMG 19:3282) covering FCGR2A-vs-2B-vs-2C-vs-3A-vs-3B discrimination. The locus is therefore one of the better-characterized clinical SD clusters for short-read PSV-based read assignment. For LLmap T1, the discriminator strategy is to combine (a) the Niederer PSV table for paralog identity, (b) read-depth over the CNV region for copy-number, (c) junction reads at the 82.5 kb LCR boundary for chimera detection.

chimeric_genes.FCGR2A_2C_chimera: NAHR product fusing 5' FCGR2A with 3' FCGR2C; reported aberrant expression
chimeric_genes.note: Mueller M et al. 2015 Genes Immun — Nonallelic homologous recombination of the FCGR2/3 locus results in copy number variation and novel chimeric FCGR2 genes.

primary.note: k=25 / mm=3 for the 82.5 kb LCR (98.5% identity → expected ~3 mismatches per 200 bp; per 25-mer ~0.4 mismatches average, mm=3 covers tail). Higher than IGHG4 (mm=2) because FCGR inter-paralog divergence is greater.

fallback_chain.name: relaxed_mismatch
fallback_chain.rationale: covers gene-converted tracts where local identity drops

fallback_chain.name: multi_position
fallback_chain.rationale: expected — 82.5 kb LCR has multiple equally-plausible paralog assignments for many reads

fallback_chain.name: junction_search_chimera
fallback_chain.trigger: chain ends within 5 kb of known FCGR2/3 LCR boundary
fallback_chain.rationale: detect NAHR chimeric FCGR2A/2C and FCGR3A/3B alleles

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: FCGR CNV is highly polymorphic; flag unknown breakpoints

test_cases.note: T2T-CHM13 resolves all five paralogs at single-copy reference state
GIAB HG002 reported as wild-type at FCGR cluster in current HPRC R2 release; recheck per release

primary_sources.note: Niederer HA, Willcocks LC, Rayner TF et al. — Copy number, linkage disequilibrium and disease association in the FCGR locus. Hum Mol Genet 19:3282-3294. PSV table for the 82.5 kb LCR and CNV detection assay design.

Breunis WB, van Mirre E, Bruin M et al. — Copy number variation at the FCGR locus includes FCGR3A, FCGR2C and FCGR3B but not FCGR2A and FCGR2B. Hum Mutat 30:E640-E650. Established the CNV boundaries of the 82.5 kb unit.

Mueller M, Barros P, Witherden AS et al. — Nonallelic homologous recombination of the FCGR2/3 locus results in copy number variation and novel chimeric FCGR2 genes with aberrant functional expression. Genes Immun 16:432-440. Mechanism and chimeric product characterization. (Originally task-cited 'Mueller 2013'; the matching FCGR-NAHR paper is the 2015 Genes Immun one.)

supporting_databases: UCSC genomicSuperDups (hg38) — captures the FCGR 82.5 kb LCR cleanly
ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity — FCGR3B haploinsufficiency (autoimmune risk)
provenance.db_coverage_note: Well represented in UCSC + ClinGen. PSV table from Niederer 2010 supplementary is the authoritative short-read PSV catalog. Not a 'pangenome_only' locus — present in GRCh38.
